annotations.text:
Name candidates — all pending domain/trademark checks before anything ships:
Numera (main page) — coined, counting/numbers, safest to clear, needs a beat to explain.
Attest — what auditors literally do; instant gravitas; common word, likely contested space.
Certa — certainty, coined; clean and quiet; least distinctive of the four.
Proof — punchiest, the product IS proof; heavily used in fintech.

Three mono directions (no green anywhere):
Attest — pure-black theatre, serif at 84px, centered. Most Rogo-like; risk: austere.
Certa — light institutional, split hero with a worksheet card (evidence-forward). Warmest; risk: quiet.
Proof — high-contrast editorial, uppercase grotesk, ruled bands. Most memorable; risk: fashion-forward for carrier buyers.
Main page runs the dark treatment under Numera — mix any name onto any direction.
